jas: quick note - staging restores hitting sporadic kms.Decrypt AccessDenied on HSM CMKs (~4%).
mina: any recent RBAC or proxy changes?
jas: we tightened ephemeral grant TTL in kms-proxy overnight (60s->25s) in canary. suspect expiry before decrypt.
ops-bot: [2026-04-01T11:02:22Z] restore-xx error: kms.Decrypt AccessDenied: principal arn:aws:sts::111:assumed-role/restore-agent not authorized to use key (kms:Decrypt) req=zzzz...
mina: short fix: revert TTL for restore aliases to 90s and run staging canary (100 decrypts).
sec-qa: classify P2. Also discovered uploader may write decrypted snap metadata to /tmp in an uncommon retry branch -> potential data exposure. filed ticket.
jas: mitigation plan: 1) temp TTL bump for alias/prod/restore + canary; 2) uploader patch to use O_TMPFILE/unlink-on-close; 3) deny direct kms:Decrypt for uploader role in prod; 4) enrich KMS audit logs with grant_id + ttl + proxy_req.
oncall: approved 30m TTL increase for restore aliases. monitor metrics and run canary.
ops-bot: [2026-04-01T11:28:30Z] canary: 0 fails /100 after TTL increase
mina: opening PRs for tmpfile fix and audit schema, will link ticket. jas: adding runbook note under encops-runbooks "ephemeral-grant-decrypt-failure".
sec-qa: good follow-ups: extend audit retention to 90d and backlog add restore-agent grant_renew on AccessDenied.
mina: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
